name: Deino
summary: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits, Deino guides Horde mages in their studies. She teaches them to master arcane and elemental forces, then sends seasoned spellcasters across Kalimdor to study ancient magic and seek distant tutors.

sections.title: The Valley's Arcanist
sections.body: Deino trains Horde mages on raised platforms in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits. Totems, huts, and quiet waters surround her place of teaching. Troll spellcasters honor spiritual traditions as they master the arcane. Deino follows this path alongside fellow instructors Enyo and Pephredo.

sections.title: Unraveling Arcane Mysteries
sections.body: Deino sends promising mages beyond Durotar to study arcane mysteries. In Ashenvale's corrupted wilds, they gather tainted Waters of Xavian and enchanted hair from the Laughing Sisters. When a student's skill outgrows Orgrimmar's teaching, Deino sends them to remote masters. One is Tabetha, a hermit sorceress in Dustwallow's swamplands.

faq.answer: Deino stands on raised platforms in southwestern Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits. Fellow troll mage trainers Enyo and Pephredo stand with her.
Deino teaches arcane, fire, and frost spells, portal creation, and essential spell ranks as mages gain experience.

faq.q: Why does Deino send mages to Xavian?
faq.answer: Xavian is an ancient city in eastern Ashenvale, now held by satyrs. Its waters are said to hold great magical power. Deino wants a sample from the bottom of its highest waterfall for study.

faq.q: Who are the trainers standing with Deino?
aliases: troll mages in valley of spirits
faq.answer: Enyo and Pephredo stand with Deino. The three share the names of the Graeae sisters of ancient myth and form Orgrimmar's central circle of troll mage mentors.

faq.q: Why does Deino send mages to Dustwallow Marsh?
faq.answer: When a mage grows more skilled, Deino sends them to Tabetha, a powerful, reclusive human hermit deep in Dustwallow Marsh. Tabetha holds specialized arcane secrets.
Yes. Horde mages of any race, including trolls, orcs, and Forsaken, can learn class spells and receive guidance from Deino in the Valley of Spirits.

angles.text: As a mage, you can learn spells and portal magic from Deino in Orgrimmar. Then you can study in Ashenvale and Dustwallow Marsh.
As a troll, you can see how the Darkspear join scholarly arcane magic with the traditions of the Valley of Spirits.
As a member of the Horde, you can find Deino in Orgrimmar's spiritual district. There she trains the faction's spellcasters alongside its shamans and warlocks.
